description: Diagnostic module to investigate the 23 failed builds from this cycle. Parse build logs for the 9 failed modules (build_start_all_sh, build_graphql_schema, build_email_guid_auth, build_mcp_detail_view_ui, build_advanced_filter_api, build_forensic_detail_api, build_manual_override_api, build_compliance_export_service, build_supervisor_auto_updater, build_email_guid_auth_compact). For each: (1) identify first error type (import, syntax, dependency, runtime); (2) check if error is transient (missing deps) vs structural (bad code); (3) output triage report with recommendation: rebuild, skip, or defer. Does NOT write to DB. Diagnostic only - outputs JSON report to stdout.
